chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Musa ibn al-Hasan, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abu Ishaq, Sahib al-Sha'ir, from Husayn al-Khorasani, and he was a baker, who said:
I complained to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) of pains in my body, so he (peace be upon him) said: 'When you pray, place your hand upon the place of your prostration, then say.'

In the Name of Allah, Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) is the Messenger of Allah! Heal me, O Healer! There is no healing except Your Healing. A healing which does not leave out any sickness, a healing from every illness and disease.
ai.seo_question: What is the specific supplication for healing mentioned in Al-Kafi?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this hadith highlights the Shia practice of ruqyah (spiritual healing) by linking physical supplication with the divine attribute of Al-Shafi, invoking healing specifically through the Prophet Muhammad. The instruction to place the hand on the site of prostration emphasizes the connection between bodily humility in prayer and the reception of divine cure, reflecting the integration of ritual and therapeutic practices in Shia jurisprudence.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Musa Bin Al Hassan, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Abu Is’haq, Sahid Al Shaeer, from Husay Al Khurasany, and he was a baker, who said, ‘I complained to Abu Abdullahasws of pains of mine, so heasws said: ‘When you pray Salāt, so place your hand upon the place of your Sajdah, then say, ‘In the Name of Allahazwj, Muhammadsaww Rasool-Allahsaww! Heal me, O Healer! There is no healing except Yourazwj Healing. A healing which not leaving out a sickness, a healing from every illness and disease’’.
en.sarwar: 15. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Musa ibn al-Hassan from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from abu Ishaq Sahih al-Sha’Ir from Husayn al-Khurasani who was a baker and has said that he once complained before abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) from pain and the Imam said the following: “
After prayer place your hand on the area for your prostration and say, ‘
In the name of Allah, Muhammad the Messenger of Allah, cure me O Healer; there is no cure except Your cure that leaves no ailment without being removed, the cure for all pain and ailments.’”
